[quote=tirakan;60763315][b]Marrins Last Defensive Line
South Gate Sector[/b]

[Spoiler]
[i]*Marrins sirens, just a few kilometres away, fill the air all the way to the men, holding tight onto their rifles in the trenches. Soon the ground begins to rumble, dozens of engines. A CA spotter maneuvres a drone into the sky and freezes*[/i]

Contact! Multiple armored vehicles, confirmed RU vanguards, at least two full battalions, moving fast! They've broken through the mine field!

[i]*the horizont drowns in a river of metal, armored carriers fanning out, dust blocking the sun light, infantry moving alongside, mortar teams taking positions and a Renaissance Union flag raised on the hill the current outpost once has stood on*[/i]

Men! Hold the line! the lieutenant shouts. If they pass us, Marrin falls! So will your children, your wifes, your mothers! We are few, but they are not too many! Men! Fire at will!

[i]*the trench erupts in muzzle flashes, the first CA rockets streak out, one slamming into a RU carrier and flipping it sideways, although the cheering's too early, as the APC's keep coming. Within a second they stand in open fire with mounted guns, ripping through the parapets. The defenders duck as stone explodes overhead, and screams for medics fill the air. The command channel, based in the cities headquarter, sends nothing but silence, the lieutenant grabs the handset, shaking it*[/i] 

Sector Command, come in! Command, we are under heavy- 

[i]*tfffft*
*Nothingness. The enemies advance closes to less than two hundred meters. One squad begins to fall back, fear rising in all directions, the morale now having reached its absolute lowpoint*[/i]

Lieutenant! Theyre about to overrun us! We have to retreat, as President Velar commanded!

[i]*the lieutenant walks up to him, grabbing his shoulder tightly*[/i]

We fight to the last man, do you understand that? You coward! Hold-

[i]*The radio snaps back to life with a blast of static.*[/i]

-lieutenant, do you copy? Repeat, do you copy?

We hear you! Were pinned down, RU forces at full charge. Where the hell were you?!

*A new voice cuts in*

This is Naerim Flight Lead. CAS cluster inbound within ten seconds. Take cover. 

[i]*The lieutenant blinks.*[/i]

Flight Lead, you are danger close. Repeat, danger-

[i]*No answer. Only the growing thunder overhead. The soldiers in the trench look up as three D-7 Valkyrs tear through the sky*[/i]

they came. These bast*rds really came.

[i]*The lieutenant lifts the radio again.*[/i]

Flight Lead, confirm payload.

[i]*the same stern voice from earlier responds*[/i]

Cluster munitions. Full spread.

[i]*the soldiers in the trenches raise their guns and yell*[/i]

Let it rain, brothers, let it rain!

[i]*The first fighter dives low,a metallic scatter, hundreds of tiny silver sparks falling from the jets belly. Seconds pass. The sky erupts. The RU spearhead vanishes in a rolling chain of concussive blasts. Fireballs dot the field in a widening storm. Screams rise, then vanish in the detonations. Vehicles flip. Dust billows skyward in thick yellow smoke. The second and third jets streak through, releasing their payloads. The ground shakes violently. The CA soldiers stare, stunned. The radio snaps on*[/i]

Lieutenant, do you copy? I repeat do yo- 

We hear you loud and clearly.

Hold the line they're not breaking through today. Naerim is currently launching an offensive on RU's northeastern front. Western reinforcements and units of the Neue Republik will arrive shortly. Set preparations for the counter. Over.
[/spoiler]
